search_artist_by_name: search the music knowledge graph for artists matching a given name query using BM25 fuzzy matching
search_song_by_name: search the music knowledge graph for songs matching a given name query using BM25 fuzzy matching
get_billboard_rank_date: get the song and artist names at a specific Billboard Hot 100 rank on a given date
grammy_get_best_artist_by_year: get the Grammy Best New Artist winners for a specific year between 1958 and 2019
get_artist_all_works: get the complete list of all works by a specific artist from the music knowledge graph
